reason: The title correctly describes a Move Class refactoring. The description, however, misdescribes the change. It frames the PR as simplifying import paths from workers submodules to the top-level workers module, and claims the workers __init__ already had the exports. The actual diff moves the class definitions from the trainer package to the workers package and edits workers/config/__init__.py. The old paths were verl.trainer.config, not verl.workers.config.actor. The description also omits deleting the trainer config code, adding the new workers files, and the edits to config.py and engine.py.
